messages:
Tara Bloom: Quick design thread — proposal to add a thin left severity strip on each stack frame row (color-coded) instead of the current right-side badge. Mock: https://figma.com/file/severity-strip (two density variants) Jonah Reed: I like left strip for scanning. Keeps the main text width stable and visually ties to timeline orientation. Keisha Thompson: Accessibility flag: color alone isn't enough. We need an accessible label (sr-only) and a non-color affordance for colorblind users (dot icon or short text). Marco Silva: Also raises an export/redaction concern: if we add a "include local vars" option for export, default should be OFF. Many customers don't want locals leaked. audit-bot: Compliance note: toggling "include locals" must create an audit event (user id + timestamp + trace id). Also show a small inline warning for sensitive fields. Tara Bloom: Microcopy suggestion for toggle: "Include local variables (may contain secrets)" with an info link to export policy. Keep the help copy concise. Keisha Thompson: Screen reader example: announce severity when row receives focus, e.g. "Frame 3: handleAuth — Severity: critical". Implementation hint: include visually-hidden text that updates with focus. Jonah Reed: Implementation idea for the strip: leave it aria-hidden and add a sibling sr-only span. Sample:```html
Severity: Critical ``` Marco Silva: Export filename nuance: if redaction is applied, append `-redacted` to filename (e.g., `trace-0xabc-redacted-2026-03-23.json`). Also sanitize and cap length. Tara Bloom: Copy affordances: propose two copy actions in the row menu: "Copy frame" and "Copy frame with context" (context includes 3 frames above/below). Default copy button on hover does plain copy. Keisha Thompson: For keyboard: make "Copy frame" reachable via the row actions menu. After copying speak via aria-live: "Frame copied to clipboard" and include context if selected ("with context"). Jonah Reed: Visual feedback: inline ephemeral check icon anchored to the frame (not global toast), dismiss after 1.2s. Avoid overlapping toasts if multiple copies happen quickly — queue or replace per-row. Marco Silva: Analytics: track `copy_action` with properties { type: "plain"|"context", include_locals: true|false, trace_id: }. Helps decide defaults. audit-bot: Redaction policy: when include_locals=true, we must run a redaction scan and mark redaction_applied=true/false in the audit log. If false, warn user before download. Tara Bloom: Edge case: mobile clipboard failures — fallback to open modal with preselected text and an explicit "Tap to copy" CTA. Show small hint: "Long-press to copy on older devices." Keisha Thompson: Also check focus order: row -> left strip (not tabbable) -> primary action -> overflow menu -> next row. Document that left strip is decorative only. Marco Silva: Dev note: server should accept `?redact=1` in export API and return sanitized payload. If user chooses include_locals, call `redact=false` and attach audit header. Tara Bloom: Next steps: I'll update Figma with strip + sr-only examples and two-copy options. @Keisha will draft SR labels & aria-live strings. @Marco will spec the export API flags and filename rules. @Jonah will prototype the per-row check animation and toast behavior. Jonah Reed: Will prototype and post a short Loom. Keisha Thompson: Drafting aria strings now, will post snippets here when ready. Marco Silva: I'll write the export API sketch and redaction flow doc. Tara Bloom: Thanks team :thumbsup: aiming to push updated mocks by EOD.
